package execmatch

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"sync"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// This test-only overlay journals actual decisions from the existing tests and
// fuzz seeds. The baseline keeps the original matcher, apart from observation
// and a copy of Decide with only its early guard removed for the guard property.
var tighteningJournal struct {
	sync.Mutex
	file    *os.File
	indexes map[*Index]string
	checked map[string]bool
}

func (ix *Index) Decide(f *Facts) Result {
	r := ix.decideObserved(f)
	ix.observeTightening(f, r)
	return r
}

func tighteningValue(v reflect.Value) any { return tighteningValueBytes(v, nil) }

func tighteningValueBytes(v reflect.Value, invalid *bool) any {
	if !v.IsValid() {
		return nil
	}
	switch v.Kind() {
	case reflect.Interface, reflect.Pointer:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return nil
		}
		return tighteningValueBytes(v.Elem(), invalid)
	case reflect.Struct:
		out := map[string]any{}
		for i := 0; i < v.NumField(); i++ {
			field := v.Type().Field(i)
			if field.IsExported() {
				out[field.Name] = tighteningValueBytes(v.Field(i), invalid)
			}
		}
		return out
	case reflect.Slice, reflect.Array:
		out := make([]any, v.Len())
		for i := range out {
			out[i] = tighteningValueBytes(v.Index(i), invalid)
		}
		return out
	case reflect.Map:
		// IDs are struct keys. Encode each key independently, then sort, so Go map
		// iteration and the seed corpus order cannot affect the comparison key.
		type entry struct {
			Key   string
			Value any
		}
		out := make([]entry, 0, v.Len())
		it := v.MapRange()
		for it.Next() {
			k, e := json.Marshal(tighteningValueBytes(it.Key(), invalid))
			if e != nil {
				panic(e)
			}
			out = append(out, entry{string(k), tighteningValueBytes(it.Value(), invalid)})
		}
		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Key < out[j].Key })
		return out
	case reflect.String:
		s := v.String()
		if !utf8.ValidString(s) {
			if invalid != nil {
				*invalid = true
			}
			// encoding/json replaces invalid UTF-8. A byte marker keeps such
			// inputs distinct, including future checked-in fuzz seeds.
			return struct{ Bytes []byte }{[]byte(s)}
		}
		return s
	case reflect.Func:
		if v.IsNil() {
			return nil
		}
		return runtime.FuncForPC(v.Pointer()).Name()
	default:
		return v.Interface()
	}
}

func tighteningDigest(v any) string {
	b, e := json.Marshal(v)
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b))
}

// A pattern's source is the comparison input. Its parsed options, path and
// operands are outputs of the implementation being compared, so hashing those
// would hide a changed reading behind different old and new input keys.
func tighteningPatternInputs(patterns []*Pattern) []any {
	var inputs []any
	for _, p := range patterns {
		if p.Runtime == "" {
			inputs = append(inputs, tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(struct {
				Entry string
				List  List
			}{p.Entry, p.List})))
			continue
		}
		inputs = append(inputs, tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(struct {
			Entry, Runtime, Tool, Argv0 string
			List                        List
			Words                       []string
		}{p.Entry, p.Runtime, p.Tool, p.Argv0, p.List, p.Words})))
	}
	return inputs
}

func (ix *Index) observeTightening(f *Facts, r Result) {
	dir := os.Getenv("TEGO_EXECMATCH_JOURNAL")
	if dir == "" {
		return
	}
	tighteningJournal.Lock()
	defer tighteningJournal.Unlock()
	if tighteningJournal.file == nil {
		file, e := os.OpenFile(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d.jsonl", dir, os.Getpid()), os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0600)
		if e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		tighteningJournal.file = file
		tighteningJournal.indexes = map[*Index]string{}
		tighteningJournal.checked = map[string]bool{}
	}
	sig, ok := tighteningJournal.indexes[ix]
	if !ok {
		if ix == nil {
			sig = "nil"
		} else {
			sig = tighteningDigest([]any{tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(ix.rows.All())), tighteningPatternInputs(ix.order), tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(ix.ids)), tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(ix.lds)), tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(ix.tools)), ix.mc != nil, ix.mcNames})
			// toolRules is private, so explicitly retain whether an implicit grant
			// lifted each tool's constraints. Pattern contents stay source inputs.
			var constraints []string
			for name, tr := range ix.tools {
				constraints = append(constraints, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%v", name, tr.constrained))
			}
			sort.Strings(constraints)
			var candidates []any
			for row, nz := range ix.nz {
				if nz.cand != nil {
					candidates = append(candidates, []any{row.Tool, nz.cand.names, tighteningValue(reflect.ValueOf(nz.cand.common))})
				}
			}
			sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool { return tighteningDigest(candidates[i]) < tighteningDigest(candidates[j]) })
			sig = tighteningDigest([]any{sig, constraints, candidates})
		}
		tighteningJournal.indexes[ix] = sig
	}
	keyFacts := *f
	// Only preparation of the explicit-empty loader vector differs between the
	// runs. Key it by the same raw loader input; the program's value is observed
	// in the decision and the regression test checks the actual empty element.
	if f.Loaded != nil && len(f.Argv) > 1 && len(f.Loaded.Argv) > 0 {
		empty := false
		for i, w := range f.Argv[1:] {
			if w == "--argv0=" || w == "--argv0" && i+2 < len(f.Argv) && f.Argv[i+2] == "" {
				empty = true
			}
		}
		if empty {
			loaded := *f.Loaded
			loaded.Argv = prepend(loaded.Path, loaded.Argv[1:])
			keyFacts.Loaded = &loaded
		}
	}
	invalid := false
	keyValue := tighteningValueBytes(reflect.ValueOf(keyFacts), &invalid)
	key := tighteningDigest([]any{sig, keyValue})
	var rawKeyFacts any
	if invalid {
		rawKeyFacts = keyValue
	}
	if os.Getenv("TEGO_EXECMATCH_SIDE") == "new" && !tighteningJournal.checked[key] {
		full := Result{Final: true, K: len(f.Argv)}
		if !ix.Empty() {
			full = ix.decide(f)
		}
		if (full.Outcome == OutcomeRefused || !full.Final) && !ix.Guarded(f) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("guard skipped full decision: %+v: %+v", f, full))
		}
		// Immutable indexes and identical facts have the same full decision.
		// Bound this acceleration cache; every result is still journaled and
		// duplicate-result consistency is independently checked by the driver.
		if len(tighteningJournal.checked) == 65536 {
			clear(tighteningJournal.checked)
		}
		tighteningJournal.checked[key] = true
	}

	var patterns []string
	if ix != nil {
		for _, p := range ix.order {
			patterns = append(patterns, p.Rule())
		}
	}
	entry := struct {
		Key, IndexSignature                string
		Outcome                            Outcome
		List                               List
		Final, Unlisted, Overflow, Guarded bool
		K                                  int
		Rule, Tool, Via, Match             string
		Facts                              *Facts
		Patterns                           []string
		RawKeyFacts                        any `json:"RawKeyFacts,omitempty"`
	}{key, sig, r.Outcome, r.List, r.Final, r.Unlisted, r.Overflow, r.Guarded, r.K, r.Rule(), r.Tool, r.Via.String(), r.Match.String(), f, patterns, rawKeyFacts}
	if e := json.NewEncoder(tighteningJournal.file).Encode(entry); e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
